summary: Reorder the existing owner app around verified status, independent brightness, Vibe, and a capability-gated Show Scores action; improve touch targets, fail closed until saved brightness loads, and provide a distinct Cart Control PWA identity without changing guest permissions or backend commands.

owner_design_gate.selected_option: Use the approved phone/iPad-first Cart Control hierarchy, 48px-or-larger everyday controls, independent saved brightness, secure capability-gated owner actions, and distinct Cart Control app icon while preserving the HBNF scoring brand and guest security mode.
owner_design_gate.approval_reference: Direct owner instructions in Cart Upgrades task on 2026-10-14
owner_design_gate.note: Source-only release candidate. No live deployment, guest permission change, backend change, or physical acceptance is claimed.

expert_basis.native_capability: Use the existing HTML owner PWA, native controls, existing pairing/status APIs, existing capability gates, and service worker. No framework or backend command is added.
expert_basis.platform_guidance: Apple recommends 44×44 point hit regions for iOS/iPadOS controls; WCAG 2.2 AA sets a 24×24 CSS-pixel minimum subject to defined exceptions. Everyday buttons are at least 48px high and sliders use 56px interaction tracks.
